summary: Helmerich & Payne filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per common share, payable December 2, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business November 18, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, activist, strategic-review, or capital-structure event is implicated. The filing is an ordinary dividend declaration, signed by Corporate Secretary William H. Gault; it contains no deal terms, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock. No special-situation or risk-arb angle applies; monitor only routine dividend sustainability.
